prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to change a flat tire safely, step by step
plan.description: A quick guide to changing a flat tire, from stopping safely to tightening the lug nuts. Learn the order that keeps you safe and gets you back on the road.

beats.narration: A flat tire can happen to anyone, and most people can fix one in minutes. The secret is order. Pull over somewhere flat and safe, turn on your hazard lights, and set the parking brake.
Gather your tools first. You need a spare tire, a jack, and a lug wrench. Check your owner's manual for where they are kept.
Loosen the lug nuts slightly while the wheel is still on the ground. Then place the jack at the spot your manual shows, and lift the car until the flat tire is clear.
Now remove the nuts and pull off the flat. Line up the spare with the bolts, push it on, and thread the nuts back by hand.
Lower the car until the tire touches the ground. Tighten the nuts in a star pattern, so the wheel sits evenly. Then lower the jack fully.
Spare tires are often temporary, so drive slowly and get the flat repaired soon. Safe spot, loosen first, lift, swap, tighten in a star. That is the whole job.
